metas.name: The Narrow Road to the Deep North
metas.description: Burma Railway in 1943 and across the Pacific during World War II, charts the cruelty of war, the tenuousness of life and the impossibility of love, as seen through the eyes of an Australian doctor and prisoner of war.

metas.name: Alien: Earth
metas.description: When a mysterious space vessel crash-lands on Earth, a young woman and a ragtag group of tactical soldiers make a fateful discovery that puts them face-to-face with the planet's greatest threat.

metas.name: Enlightened
metas.description: A self-destructive woman who has a spiritual awakening becomes determined to live an enlightened life, creating havoc at home and work.

metas.name: Rectify
metas.description: Daniel Holden must put his life back together after serving 19 years on Georgia's Death Row before DNA evidence calls his conviction into question.

metas.name: Pluribus
metas.description: In a world overtaken by a mysterious wave of forced happiness, Carol Sturka, one of the immune few, must uncover what's really going on - and save humanity from its artificial bliss.

metas.name: Looking
metas.description: Three best friends living in San Francisco share the nuances and complexities of contemporary gay relationships as they explore a variety of options, both in love and in life.

metas.name: The Terror
metas.description: Supernatural, semihistorical horror anthology series, where each season is inspired by a different infamous or mysterious real-life historical tragedy.

metas.name: The Knick
metas.description: Set in New York in 1900, The Knick centers around the groundbreaking Knickerbocker Hospital.

metas.name: The Chair Company
metas.description: Tim Robinson stars as Ron, a family man who investigates a conspiracy after an embarrassing incident at work.

metas.name: Heated Rivalry
metas.description: Two rival hockey stars at the top of their game face an unexpected challenge when they develop feelings for each other, complicating their careers and the sport's expectations.

metas.name: Patriot
metas.description: Follows the complicated life of intelligence officer John Tavner, whose latest assignment--to prevent Iran from going nuclear--requires him to forgo all safety nets and assume a perilous, non-official cover.

metas.name: Channel Zero
metas.description: An anthology series based on creepypastas.

metas.name: Undone
metas.description: After she very narrowly survives a serious car accident, a woman discovers that she has a new relationship with time.

metas.name: Joe Pera Talks with You
metas.description: Joe, beloved choir teacher, discusses topics of interest. First up, iron!

metas.name: The Curse
metas.description: A newlywed couple struggle to make their vision for eco-living a reality in a small New Mexico town.

metas.name: Scavengers Reign
metas.description: The crew of a damaged deep space freighter are stranded on a beautiful but dangerous planet.

metas.name: Beef
metas.description: A minor conflict spirals into a consuming feud between two individuals, exposing pride, resentment, and hidden pain.

metas.name: Ripley
metas.description: A grifter named Ripley living in New York during the 1960s is hired by a wealthy man to bring his vagabond son home from Italy.

metas.name: Irma Vep
metas.description: Mira is an American movie star disillusioned by her career and recent breakup, who comes to France to star as Irma Vep in a remake of the French silent film classic, "Les Vampires."

metas.name: Pantheon
metas.description: A young woman starts to get messages from an unknown number that claims to be her deceased father. Trying to uncover the truth, she stumbles upon a larger conspiracy involving the singularity.

metas.name: How To with John Wilson
metas.description: An anxious New Yorker attempts to give everyday advice while dealing with his own personal issues.

metas.name: The Leftovers
metas.description: Three years after the disappearance of 2% of the global human population, a group of people in a small New York community try to continue their lives while coping with the tragedy of the unexplained nature of the event.

metas.name: Station Eleven
metas.description: A post apocalyptic saga spanning multiple timelines, telling the stories of survivors of a devastating flu as they attempt to rebuild and reimagine the world anew while holding on to the best of what's been lost.

metas.name: Devs
metas.description: A computer engineer investigates the secretive development division in her company, which she believes is behind the disappearance of her boyfriend.

metas.name: The Rehearsal
metas.description: Nathan Fielder gives people a chance to rehearse for their own lives in a world where nothing ever works out as expected.

metas.name: Inside No. 9
metas.description: Genre-mixing anthology series, inviting viewers into some very different and enigmatic No. 9s.

metas.name: Interview with the Vampire
metas.description: A vampire tells his epic story of love, blood, and the perils of immortality to a journalist.
